test_ScanNetDataset_getitem: test the ScanNetDataset getitem method to verify point cloud loading and augmentation pipelines
test_ScanNetDataset_evaluate: test the ScanNetDataset evaluate method to compute AP metrics for 3D bounding box predictions
test_ScanNetDataset_show: test the ScanNetDataset show method to export point clouds and predictions as OBJ and PLY files
run_test_scannet_getitem: run pytest on test_getitem to validate ScanNetDataset data loading with IndoorPointSample and RandomFlip3D pipelines
run_test_scannet_evaluate: run pytest on test_evaluate to validate ScanNetDataset AP computation at 0.25 and 0.5 IoU thresholds
